headline: Recommended denial of 181-185 Felton Street zone change; denied ANR plan for 103 Clark Lane.
summary: The petitioner's attorney asked to extend the Riverfront Overlay District to the rear, Residence C part of 181-185 Felton Street, without changing its underlying zoning. Members said the overlay could be used as a loophole and could open the door for other properties, but they would look favorably on a revised plan that keeps the residential character along Noonan Street. No one came to represent the 103 Clark Lane plan, and the minutes of the June 3rd and June 10th meetings were approved.
decisions: Denied the ANR Plan for 103 Clark Lane as presented.
Recommended denial of the 181-185 Felton Street zone change, 4-2.
Approved the minutes of the June 3rd and June 10th meetings.

transcript:
# CITY OF WALTHAM

## BOARD OF SURVEY AND PLANNING

WALTHAM, MASSACHUSETTS

## BOARD OF SURVEY AND PLANNING MINUTES

The following are minutes of the 6:00 PM, October 7, 2026, meeting. It was held in the Public Meeting Room of the Arthur Clark Government Center located at 119 School Street, Waltham Ma. In attendance were Chairman William Creonte, and members, Keefner, Moroney, DiVito, Tarallo and Barrett

The Chairman opened the Public Hearing at 6:00 PM and immediately closed the Public Hearing. He informed the public that the meeting was being recorded by the local Waltham Cable Access Channel and stated if anyone was planning to speak, they were required to sign in.

The Clerk read the first item on the agenda which was for the ANR Plan for 103 Clark Lane. The Chairman recused himself and turned the chair over to Vice Chairman Keefner. The Board initially agreed to defer the item to the end of the meeting to allow time for someone to come and represent. By the end of the meeting no one came to represent.

***On the motion of Mr. Barrett, seconded by Mr. Moroney, the Board***

***VOTED: To deny the ANR Plan for 103 Clark Lane as presented***

The Clerk read the next item on the agenda which was for the Discussion and Recommendations from the joint City Council meeting held on September 28th, 2026, regarding the applications for 181-185 Felton Street Zone Change to Amend the Zoning District Map. Attorney Michael Connors came forward representing the petitioner. They are requesting extending the Riverfront Overlay District to include the rear (Residency C) portion only-not changing the underlying zoning of 181-185 Felton Street. The single lot is spilt into two zones: the front portion is Commercial with the Riverfront Overlay; the rear portion (18,000 sq ft) is Residence C without the Riverfront Overlay. The split results from a leftover lot line from the 1952 zoning change. The front commercial portion alone is 11,754 sq ft, below the 25,000 sq ft minimum. The Board expressed concerns that they don't like the fact that the overlay district is being used as a loophole to rezone a property for use that was not intended. And if they approve this petition, it could open the door for other property owners to creep into residential areas and allow people to add properties to an overlay district. The Board mentioned it would look favorably on a revised submission that preserves the residential character along Noonan Street. The Board voted 4-2.

***On the motion of Mr. Moroney, seconded by Mr. Barrett, the Board***

***VOTED: To recommend denial of the plan as submitted***

The Clerk read the next item on the agenda, which was the approval of the meeting minutes to the June 3rd and June 10 meeting.

***On the motion of Mr. DeVito, seconded by Mr. Moroney, the Board***

***VOTED: To approve the minutes to the June 3rd and June 10th meeting***

***Meeting adjourned at 6:38 p.m.***

Respectfully submitted,

Michael L. J. Chiasson, Clerk

Board of Survey and Planning
